notes.movements: No movement is reported here. The Korean War has been under an armistice since 27 July 1953. The card below is a layout example with no unit and no event.
notes.casualties: No daily casualty figure is included. Inventing a body count would look like fighting that this file does not have.
notes.units: Background only: the two Koreas keep large forces on either side of the Demilitarized Zone. This is not a new deployment.
notes.territory: No territory change is included. The armistice line is shown as reference geography, not as a front that moved.
notes.weapons: Background only, from public encyclopedic descriptions. Not a list of weapons used today.
